findings.note: VSiN leans Rays moneyline at +162 but notes Martinez's 15.1% strikeout rate, a 3.97 xERA and a .309/.344/.470 line with a 5.15 ERA the third time through the order, which raises the risk of an early hook before 14 outs.
SportsLine's Game 1 preview confirms Martinez starts against Misiorowski, with Milwaukee at about -198, and says Martinez has a 6.10 ERA over his last five games against the Brewers.

ESPN confirms Martinez starts Game 1 on five days' rest after 5⅓ innings (16 outs) in ALCS Game 4; MLB.com says his two postseason starts total 9 innings, so the other was about 11 outs, which splits around the 13.5 line.
